summary: On 27 Oct the S&P 500 rose 0.6% and the Nasdaq 1.2%, with chip stocks leading after Anthropic's IPO filing; Kospi gained 3.1% and the Nikkei 1.7%, while Hong Kong and London fell on HSBC's revenue miss. Brent fell 1.7% to about $113.88 on US-Iran diplomacy even as the Houthis claimed a strike on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery; gold rose 0.9% and the US 10-year yield sat near 5.0%. The Brazilian real retraced about 4% after the previous session's election-driven spike, EU gas storage was about 74.6% full, and Boeing and Xylem fell sharply on results. The Fed's two-day meeting opened with no decision published yet.

climate.detail: Allocation falls from 36 to 23 billion cubic metres; lake at 36.7% usable storage on 14 Oct, projected near 9% by end-2027, a risk to Zambian and Zimbabwean hydropower.
climate.source: Zambezi River Authority statement, reported by Zambia Monitor 15 Oct 2026

climate.headline: Pre-COP31 held in Fiji and Tuvalu ahead of Antalya talks on 9-20 November
climate.detail: Australia and Pacific island nations convened ministers 5-8 Oct; Turkiye and Australia share the COP31 presidency. The UNFCCC page lists no Article 6 items yet.
climate.source: UNFCCC, Road to Antalya page (items to 14 Oct 2026)

climate.headline: Cyclone Arnab nears Andhra Pradesh coast with over 114,000 evacuated
climate.detail: IMD expected a very severe cyclonic storm to make landfall near Visakhapatnam around 2-4 am on 28 Oct, with winds of 125-135 km/h; flights and trains cancelled, Odisha schools shut in 16 districts.
climate.source: India Meteorological Department bulletin of 27 Oct 2026, as reported by The Week
